aforecapital-gamma-app:ashbyhq:4b2c97d1-.title: Software Engineer, Data Systems
aforecapital-gamma-app:ashbyhq:4b2c97d1-.company: Pre-Seed Series a Series b Series c Series D Series E IPO Gamma AI Build beautiful presentations with generative AI. Bay Area
aforecapital-gamma-app:ashbyhq:4b2c97d1-.description: ABOUT THE ROLE You'll own Gamma's data infrastructure and architecture as we scale to hundreds of millions of users and petabytes of data. This means defining the technical strategy for our end-to-end event pipeline architecture, designing distributed systems that handle massive scale with reliability, and establishing the foundation for how data flows through Gamma. You'll solve the hardest data engineering challenges we face while setting the technical direction for data infrastructure across the company. As a Staff Data Engineer, you'll balance hands-on engineering with technical leadership. You'll architect solutions for orders of magnitude growth, mentor engineers across the organization, and drive strategic decisions about our data stack. You'll work closely with analytics, product, and engineering leadership to enable data-driven decision making at scale while building systems that serve millions of users and inform critical business decisions. Our team has a strong in-office culture and works in person 4–5 days per week in San Francisco. We love working together to stay creative and connected, with flexibility to work from home when focus matters most. WHAT YOU'LL DO - Own and evolve our end-to-end event pipeline architecture, from Kafka ingestion through Snowflake analytics, setting technical direction for data infrastructure - Design and architect distributed data systems that scale to orders of magnitude more data volume while maintaining world-class query performance - Lead initiatives to build and optimize CDC (change data capture) pipelines and streaming data transformations at massive scale - Establish best practices for data quality, pipeline reliability, and system observability across the organization - Drive strategic technical decisions about data modeling, infrastructure architecture, and technology choices - Mentor engineers and elevate data engineering practices across analytics, product, and engineering teams WHAT YOU'LL BRING - 10+ years as a data or software engineer with deep expertise in distributed systems, data infrastructure, and high-growth SaaS products at massive scale - Expert-level knowledge of Apache Kafka (producers, consumers, Kafka Connect, stream processing) and event streaming platforms - Extensive hands-on experience with Snowflake, including performance optimization, cost management, and data modeling; strong foundation in Postgres, CDC patterns, and replication strategies - Proven track record architecting and leading major data infrastructure initiatives through orders-of-magnitude growth - Experience establishing best practices and driving technical strategy across organizations - Strong communication skills with a history of influencing technical direction across engineering, analytics, and leadership - Proficiency with dbt, Terraform, and working knowledge of data governance, privacy compliance (GDPR, CCPA), and security best practices COMPENSATION RANGE: The base salary for this full-time position, which spans multiple internal levels depending on qualifications, ranges between $230K - $310K plus benefits & equity. Final offer amounts are determined by multiple factors, including but not limited to experience and expertise in the requirements listed above. If you're interested in this role but you don't meet every requirement, we encourage you to apply anyway! We're always excited about meeting great people.

beedie-beedie:lever:f21e47ae-0850-4f70-9.title: Project Coordinator, Industrial Construction
beedie-beedie:lever:f21e47ae-0850-4f70-9.description: At Beedie, we foster talent, encourage innovation, and reward success. We’re always looking for like-minded people to join our team and share our passion for doing the best work of our lives. Our approach is simple: we work hard, we have fun, and we make a difference. And, we’ve been recognized as a top employer provincially and nationally. Our people are the heart and soul of our organization. If you are passionate, hardworking, ambitious, and want to be part of a dynamic and growing company that will take your career forward, join us. Since 1954, Beedie has combined innovation and craftsmanship to bring new possibilities to life. Today, we are one of Canada’s largest industrial and residential developers, having completed more than 35 million square feet of new development across BC, Alberta, southern Ontario, and Las Vegas, Nevada. With multiple industrial projects currently under construction and 9 projects totaling over 1.5M SF currently in development across the GTA, Beedie is looking for talented individuals to join our growing Ontario team as we continue to be built for good. As one of Canada’s largest private industrial developers, Beedie is excited to be growing our Toronto team! We are currently seeking a Project Coordinator to join our expanding team managing various Beedie projects. This position will work with our Project Management Team and external consultant team from design and building permit coordination through to project completion. In addition, this position provides the opportunity to act as an Owner's Representative on select projects, gaining direct experience in client-side project oversight. Responsibilities include overall construction performance including all aspects of pre-construction and construction, involving planning, scheduling, administration of contracts, supervising, and project reporting. This role also offers the opportunity to take ownership of select, scoped projects independently to help expand your knowledgebase while still having support from a Project Manager.
responsibilities: Assist with preparation of conceptual project budgets
Assist with preparation of preliminary design schedules and construction schedules
Assist with preparation of permit packages by coordinating drawings and information required for the application and approval process and assist in obtaining all other municipal permits
Assist in the preparation and issuance of the project tender packages, including scopes of work customized for the specific project
Prepare and review bid analysis spreadsheets and recommendations for contractor and vendor selections
Prepare prime contract, consultant services agreements and vendor purchase orders for execution
Internal project schedule updates and construction status reporting
Attend and participate in project meetings as required
Provide meeting minutes for applicable meetings as directed
Set up and maintain record files to ensure that all project information is appropriately documented and secured
Review, submit and maintain tracking log for RFI’s and shop drawings
Ensure shop drawings are submitted in accordance with the Project Schedule
Assist with approvals and accounting entries for project change orders

Manage the change management process by reviewing all incoming change requests for scope justification and pricing accuracy, maintaining a current change log, and updating online software for approved changes

Own project document control across all phases of construction, maintaining a comprehensive and up-to-date filing system for all submittals, RFIs, change management, drawings, meeting minutes, and project correspondence
Assist in the processing of progress billings from contractors, consultants, and other vendors
Monitor the site progress and the quality of the work completed. Identify and address any deviations from the project timelines or specifications.
Coordinate and collect all close-out documents including as-build record drawings, warranties, operating and maintenance manuals

Manage the close-out process from an ownership perspective, ensuring all service contracts, warranties, and maintenance agreements are properly executed, organized, and transitioned to the building owner and/or tenant upon project completion.
Other duties as required
qualifications: A minimum of 2-4 years of relevant work experience in industrial or institutional construction
The ability to travel throughout GTA with access to your own vehicle
A technical Diploma or relevant University Degree
Exceptional written and oral communication skills
Passion for construction and project management
Recognized analytical and research skills
The ability to handle a heavy workload, multitask and prioritize
A strong work ethic, attention to detail, and excellent organizational skills
A desire for continuous learning and professional development within the construction and real estate development industry

heritageholding-heritage-holding:ashbyhq.title: Senior Structural Engineer
heritageholding-heritage-holding:ashbyhq.description: SENIOR STRUCTURAL ENGINEER Company: Confidential Location: Illinois (Onsite) Employment Type: Full-time ABOUT THE FIRM Heritage Holding is working with a well-established structural engineering consulting firm serving architecture firms, building owners, and developers. The firm has built a strong reputation for providing structural design and forensic engineering services for buildings and special structures, delivering highly detailed, fully constructible drawings that minimize change orders and keep projects on schedule. The company maintains long-term relationships with architecture-firm clients across both new construction and renovation projects. The company name is being withheld at this stage of the search and will be shared with candidates who advance in the process. POSITION OVERVIEW The firm is seeking a Senior Structural Engineer to take on a client-facing technical leadership role responsible for structural design, quality control, and day-to-day management of client relationships on building and special-structure projects. The successful candidate will bring deep technical expertise, sound engineering judgment, and the maturity to represent the firm directly with architecture-firm clients. THE OPPORTUNITY - Step into an established, senior-level book of business; inheriting long-tenured client relationships and an active project pipeline from day one, not building from scratch - Join a firm that is investing in growth, with the backing and resources to expand its project pipeline, team, and capabilities over the coming years - A path to greater leadership responsibility, with the opportunity for equity participation over time for the right person KEY RESPONSIBILITIES - Lead structural design and analysis for new construction and renovation projects, including steel, concrete, masonry, and wood structures - Review and stamp structural drawings and calculations as the engineer of record - Serve as a primary point of contact for architecture-firm and building-owner clients, managing day-to-day communication and expectations - Produce highly detailed, constructible documents that anticipate field conditions and minimize change orders - Support forensic engineering assignments, including existing-building evaluations and condition assessments - Mentor junior engineers and provide technical quality control across project teams - Coordinate with project managers on scope, schedule, and budget for assigned projects - Represent the firm in client meetings, site visits, and project coordination calls REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS - Bachelor's degree in Civil or Structural Engineering (or closely related field) - 15–20 years of progressive structural engineering experience, including buildings and special structures - Active Structural Engineer (SE) license - Demonstrated experience serving as engineer of record on building projects - Strong working knowledge of applicable building codes and design standards - Proven ability to manage client relationships directly, with excellent written and verbal communication skills - Experience mentoring or leading junior engineering staff PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS - Experience with forensic engineering or existing-building evaluation work - Familiarity with AutoCAD and/or Revit structural workflows - Prior experience working directly with architecture firms as primary clients - Business development or client-growth experience

You will collaborate closely with RTL, STA, DFT, package, and CAD teams to solve challenging implementation and signoff issues. The position also offers the opportunity to shape physical design methodologies, automation, and engineering best practices. Drive PPA and reliability optimization: Analyze and optimize timing, congestion, power, IR drop, electromigration, and signal integrity across advanced technology nodes. Manage signoff closure: Identify and resolve implementation issues and ensure high-quality closure across timing, power, area, and reliability requirements. Provide technical leadership: Participate in technical reviews, establish best practices, and proactively identify implementation bottlenecks and risks. Mentor engineers: Guide junior team members, share technical expertise, and contribute to the development of a strong physical design engineering culture. Drive innovation: Explore emerging approaches, including AI/ML-assisted design optimization, to improve physical implementation workflows and outcomes. Requirements: Experience: 12+ years of hands-on experience in ASIC/SoC physical design implementation. Education: Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Electronics, Electrical Engineering, VLSI, or a related technical discipline. EDA expertise: Strong proficiency with industry-standard physical design and signoff tools such as Cadence Innovus, Synopsys ICC2, PrimeTime, and StarRC. Physical design: Deep understanding of floorplanning, power planning, placement, clock-tree synthesis, routing, optimization, physical verification, and signoff. Timing & reliability: Strong knowledge of timing closure, low-power design techniques, signal integrity, IR/EM analysis, and physical verification. Advanced nodes: Experience working on advanced semiconductor technology nodes, with 7nm, 5nm, or 3nm experience preferred. Automation: Strong scripting capabilities in Tcl, Perl, and/or Python for flow development, automation, and methodology improvements. Advanced packaging: Knowledge of package-aware implementation and multi-die or chiplet architectures is advantageous. jobgether-jobgether:lever:bbfebf29-3abc-.description: This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Business Operations Manager based in Portugal. As Business Operations Manager, you’ll play a central role in ensuring commercial operations run smoothly across the EMEA region. You’ll act as the operational bridge between Commercial, Customer Success, Finance, Legal, HQ Operations, and external partners. Your scope will span the full commercial lifecycle, from quotations and orders through provisioning, invoicing, renewals, and partner operations. This is an independent, hands-on role where you’ll own issues, coordinate stakeholders, and drive solutions rather than simply provide administrative support. You’ll help identify operational bottlenecks and turn recurring challenges into scalable, standardized processes. Working in a fast-growing healthcare technology environment, you’ll have meaningful exposure to international markets and cross-functional initiatives. The role offers an opportunity to make a tangible impact on operational efficiency while helping support continued expansion across EMEA. Manage quotations and orders by preparing quotes and order forms, reviewing purchase orders, coordinating approvals, and ensuring accurate handovers between Commercial and operational teams. Coordinate order processing and license provisioning, ensuring customer and partner information is complete and resolving operational blockers efficiently. Support invoicing and accounts receivable activities by ensuring invoice readiness, coordinating with Finance, monitoring invoice status and overdue receivables, and resolving billing or documentation issues. Manage renewal operations by maintaining visibility of upcoming renewals, coordinating preparation across relevant teams and partners, and proactively tracking risks and outstanding actions. Support distributor and commercial partner operations, including onboarding, documentation, system access, internal setup, and alignment with operational processes. Coordinate operational requirements for new EMEA markets, working across Commercial, Legal, Finance, Regulatory, Customer Success, and HQ teams. Take ownership of day-to-day commercial operational issues by establishing clear owners and deadlines, coordinating stakeholders, removing bottlenecks, and driving matters through to resolution. Identify recurring operational challenges and develop scalable processes that improve turnaround times, reduce rework, and minimize unnecessary escalations to senior management. Monitor operational performance through metrics such as order-processing times, provisioning lead times, renewal readiness, partner onboarding, AR follow-up, and completion of agreed actions. Requirements: Approximately 4–7 years of experience in Business Operations, Commercial Operations, Order Management, or a related operational role. Experience supporting B2B commercial operations, preferably across multiple countries or international markets. Strong understanding of quotations, purchase orders, invoicing, renewals, and order-to-cash processes. Proven ability to coordinate effectively across Commercial, Finance, Legal, Customer Success, Operations, and external stakeholders. Highly organized, detail-oriented, and proactive, with a strong sense of ownership and reliable follow-through. Comfortable working independently and taking initiative in a fast-growing, evolving environment where processes may still be developing. Experience using CRM platforms and other business systems to manage operational workflows and information. Strong written and spoken English, with the ability to communicate clearly with stakeholders across different functions and geographies. Experience in SaaS, healthcare, medical devices, healthcare IT, or another technology-driven environment is a plus. Strong problem-solving skills and the ability to turn operational issues into practical, repeatable solutions. Benefits: Full-ti

jobgether-jobgether:lever:c3437077-73c4-.description: This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Property Management Account Manager based in France. This is a fully remote opportunity for an experienced property management professional to take ownership of a diverse portfolio and its day-to-day operations. You’ll serve as a key point of contact for clients and tenants, building strong relationships while ensuring properties are managed efficiently. The role combines operational oversight, communication, team coordination, and independent problem-solving. You’ll be expected to navigate complex situations that may not have straightforward answers, using sound judgment and a proactive mindset. Starting with a portfolio of around 100 units, you’ll have the opportunity to scale toward 150, 200, or more units as your performance grows. It’s an ideal environment for an adaptable, resilient professional who thrives on responsibility, fast-paced work, and continuous improvement. Serve as the primary point of contact for client and tenant communications, managing relationships professionally and ensuring timely, effective responses. Oversee the day-to-day operations of an assigned property portfolio, maintaining high standards of service and operational performance. Manage a portfolio that may range from approximately 70 units for standard performers to 350 units for top performers. Handle daily communication workflows, primarily through written correspondence and email, with occasional outbound phone calls. Take ownership of portfolio growth, with an initial target of approximately 100 units and the opportunity to scale to 150, 200, or more units based on performance. Coordinate workflows and oversee team performance, including supervising, guiding, and holding Virtual Assistants accountable. Identify and resolve unusual or complex operational issues that may fall outside established procedures, manuals, or FAQs. Apply critical thinking, initiative, and sound judgment to determine appropriate solutions in ambiguous situations. De-escalate conflicts with clients and tenants calmly and professionally while maintaining positive relationships. Adapt quickly to changing priorities and operational demands while maintaining a high level of service and attention to detail. Requirements: Previous professional experience in property management, particularly as a Leasing Agent, Property Management Assistant, Property Manager, or in a comparable property operations position. Demonstrated ability to oversee daily property operations, workflows, and team performance. Excellent written and verbal English communication skills, with confidence managing clients, tenants, and team members. Experience supervising, guiding, delegating to, and holding Virtual Assistants or remote team members accountable. Strong critical-thinking and problem-solving abilities, with the confidence to make sound decisions when situations are complex or solutions are not explicitly documented. Highly adaptable and resourceful, with a proactive, self-directed, and autodidactic approach to learning and problem-solving. Strong organizational skills and the ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced operational environment. Calm and professional approach to conflict resolution, with resilience and a consistently positive attitude. Availability to work U.S. business hours. A quiet, dedicated home-office environment suitable for professional calls and focused work. Reliable internet connection of at least 10 Mbps, with a backup internet connection available. jobgether-jobgether:lever:ed7c5d61-a9f1-.description: This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Project Manager - Content Operations based in India. This role is an opportunity to drive the operational excellence behind a rapidly scaling educational content ecosystem. You will coordinate projects, documentation, publishing workflows, and cross-functional initiatives across content teams. The position combines project management, stakeholder coordination, content operations, and quality control. You will help ensure that hundreds of content assets move efficiently from creation through their final publishing stage. You’ll also coordinate interns and vendors while maintaining high standards for accuracy, consistency, and platform readiness. Working remotely, you’ll collaborate with teams across India and internationally, with occasional travel required. The role is ideal for an organized, proactive professional who enjoys creating structure and keeping complex initiatives moving forward. Maintain a centralized, well-organized repository covering partner interactions, agreements, project documentation, and project statuses, ensuring continuity when team members or consultants transition. Act as the primary point of contact for assigned Jira requests, triaging and routing tickets to the appropriate Math, Science, or Localization leads and ensuring deadlines are tracked and met. Own the final stage of content publishing, including video descriptions, SEO optimization, thumbnails, timestamps, and other platform-readiness requirements. Coordinate interns and external vendors performing content operations tasks, providing clear direction and quality control while allowing specialist content teams to remain focused on content creation. Drive cross-functional projects involving multiple teams by establishing timelines, following up on deliverables, identifying blockers, and ensuring accountability across stakeholders. Maintain alignment with established platform and publishing standards as the content library scales to more than 1,300 videos. Monitor project progress, surface risks and dependencies, and communicate relevant updates to stakeholders in a clear and timely manner. Support operational improvements that make content workflows more efficient, scalable, consistent, and resilient. Maintain strong documentation and knowledge-sharing practices so project context and operational decisions remain accessible to relevant teams. Requirements Demonstrated experience in project management, content operations, program coordination, publishing operations, or a similar cross-functional role. Strong organizational and project-tracking skills, with the ability to manage multiple priorities, deadlines, stakeholders, and workflows simultaneously. Experience coordinating projects across teams where responsibilities and decision-making authority are distributed. Strong communication and follow-up skills, with the confidence to drive accountability without direct managerial authority. Experience working with project-management or ticketing tools such as Jira, along with strong proficiency in documentation and collaboration platforms. High attention to detail and a strong understanding of content quality, publishing workflows, SEO, metadata, and digital content hygiene. Experience managing interns, contractors, vendors, or other distributed contributors is an advantage. Ability to identify process gaps, resolve operational issues, and introduce practical improvements as workflows scale. Comfortable working in a remote environment with distributed and potentially international teams. Proactive, dependable, adaptable, and capable of working independently while maintaining strong cross-functional collaboration. Strong written and spoken English, with the ability to communicate clearly with both technical and functional stakeholders. Experience in education, digital content, technology, media, or nonprofit environments

southparkcommons-orb:ashbyhq:fd6cf13a-fe.title: Senior Software Engineer, Real Time Analytics - San Francisco HQ
southparkcommons-orb:ashbyhq:fd6cf13a-fe.description: About Orb: We’re a team that cares deeply about the work, the people we do it with, and the customers we do it for. Everyone at Orb has real ownership over their work, direct access to customers, and a voice in how the company grows. We’re building the revenue design platform that helps teams automate billing, evolve pricing, and grow revenue with confidence. Looking ahead, joining forces with Adyen expands what we can build and raises the ceiling on the problems we get to solve for customers. The challenges are uniquely interesting, and you’ll be surrounded by thoughtful, ambitious people who move fast and hold a high bar. For San Francisco Bay Area , New York, and Amsterdam residents, we've built a hybrid work culture where we are in office 3 days/week. For remote roles, we ask you to join us in person 1x per quarter. Our values, customer centricity, minutes matter, run with it, attention to detail, and go further together are at the core of everything we do. About the role: Every usage-based business eventually asks the same three questions in real time: what has this customer consumed, what are they entitled to, and what should happen next? This team owns the runtime layer where billing state becomes something customers can act on — alerting, spend controls, entitlement checks, and usage analytics. This is a foundational role. Enterprise and AI customers increasingly treat entitlements, spend controls, and real-time analytics as a single problem rather than three separate features, which makes this one of the highest-leverage areas of Orb's roadmap. You'll help set the direction, the primitives, and the interfaces other teams build against. The work sits squarely at the intersection of infrastructure and product. On one side, it's real systems engineering: alerts, balances, and entitlement checks computed against actual tiers, credits, and commits, fast and reliably enough to stand behind latency guarantees. On the other, it's a customer-facing product surface where API design, clarity, and getting the primitives right matter as much as the systems underneath. You'll spend as much time understanding what customers are trying to do as you will building the thing that does it. You'll build the system customers rely on to know, in real time, what's been consumed, what's allowed, and what should happen next — the reactive side that alerts the moment a limit is crossed, and the proactive side that serves live balance and entitlement state on demand. Because it runs against Orb's real pricing, credits, and commits, customers can put it directly in the critical path of their own spend and access decisions — the layer they reach for as they scale. In this role you will: - Own a product surface end to end — from customer conversations and product design through API design, implementation, and rollout - Design and ship alerting and analytics that are granular, flexible, and fast enough to carry contractual latency SLAs - Build the entitlement and spend-control primitives (credit balances, allocations, usage-percentage alerts, rate limits) that enforce against Orb's real billing state in real time - Shape the roadmap, primitives, and interfaces other teams build against — foundational decisions that are still open - Collaborate across PM, design, sales, and customer success, and work directly with enterprise and AI customers to turn their pain points into what we build About you: - 6+ years of software engineering experience, with a track record of owning products or systems end to end - Energized by ambiguity and ownership — you want a say in what gets built, not just how - Strong product instincts and genuine customer empathy; you like being close to customers and to the business impact of your work (this is revenue-adjacent, and people trust these numbers) - Comfortable designing APIs and data models that other teams and customers depend on - Enough systems depth to reason clearly about real-time and low-latency tradeoffs — this t
